ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white regions on the bilateral lobes; thick black border along the trailing edge margins; central vertical black column originating at the median notch; distributed dark punctate mottling within the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate internal angle of 45 degrees; significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels along the entire boundary from tip to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the majority of the trailing edge, tapering toward the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular white ring-shaped pixel clusters localized primarily along the dark trailing edge and lower central axis.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned diagonal and vertical linear streaks visible on the left lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible textured clusters (barnacle colonization) with orange and off-white pixel values on both the left and right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct orange-hued pixel concentrations localized at the extreme lateral tips of the fluke lobes.
